title: Abellana, CKBA book spots in SBP junior basketball national finals

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Abellana National School (ANS) and Coach Kid Basketball Academy (CKBA) booked their tickets to Manila after ruling their divisions in the Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas (SBP) Central Visayas Zone Finals over the weekend at the Cebu City Sports Institute. The ANS high school girls team, composed of former Palarong Pambansa silver medalists, defeated Got Shot, 60-39. CKBA dominated the Disciples, 93-65, to claim the championship titles. Governor’s Cup: Talisay routs Ronda by 93; Aloguinsan dominates Oslob Abellana girls’ star turn Both teams will represent SBP Zone 8 or Central Visayas in the SBP National Junior Championships scheduled from December […]...
